title: Retrosynthesis of Synthetic Media for Explainable AI Provenance Forensics
abstract: arXiv:2609.02268v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the rapid proliferation of generative models on Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS) platforms, reliably tracing the provenance of synthetic media without modifying generator architectures or parameters remains a major challenge. In this work, we propose a self-referential retrosynthesis framework for explainable AI provenance forensics under a fixed-generator setting. The framework leverages a jointly optimized encoder-decoder pair to implement a self-embedding mechanism that enables round-trip consistency verification. During inference, client inputs are first encoded and then processed by the generator to produce outputs with high visual fidelity. For forensic verification, the consistency between the resynthesized image and the query image is analyzed to determine whether the image originates from the target generative model. Our approach eliminates the need for watermark embedding or modifications to the generation process.

translated_title: 面向可解释AI溯源取证的合成媒体逆合成方法
translated_abstract: 随着生成式模型在机器学习即服务（MLaaS）平台上的快速普及，在不修改生成器架构或参数的情况下可靠地追踪合成媒体的来源仍然是一个重大挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种在固定生成器设置下用于可解释AI溯源取证的自指逆合成框架。该框架利用联合优化的编码器-解码器对来实现自嵌入机制，从而支持往返一致性验证。在推理过程中，客户端输入首先被编码，然后由生成器处理以产生具有高视觉保真度的输出。在取证验证时，通过分析重合成图像与查询图像之间的一致性来判断该图像是否来源于目标生成模型。我们的方法无需嵌入水印或修改生成过程。
tldr: 提出了一种基于联合优化编码器-解码器实现自嵌入与往返一致性验证的逆合成框架，可在不修改生成器、不嵌入水印的情况下对合成媒体进行可解释的AI溯源取证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a self-referential retrosynthesis framework using a jointly optimized encoder-decoder pair for round-trip consistency verification, enabling explainable AI provenance forensics of synthetic media without modifying the generator or embedding watermarks.
